description: Get the text of a Polish company's articles of association or statute from the court register document repository. Use for questions about share transfers, pre-emption rights, voting rights, management board powers or company duration. Identify the company by name, KRS number or company tax number (NIP).

doc_id.description: Optional: specific rar_doc_id. Omit for the latest articles / statute.

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

name: get_company_articles_of_association
title: Get Articles of Association
